build.beforeDevCommand: npm run sidecar && npm --prefix frontend run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run sidecar && npm --prefix frontend run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Versão desktop offline do FinanSee Web
bundle.longDescription: FinanSee Desktop: a versão local do FinanSee Web para lançamentos, categorias, dashboard e backup.
